summary: FinPilot iter-3 testing complete. Backend: 45/45 pytest tests pass (100%) — covers all 6 new iter-3 endpoints (super-chart with range/inflation, allocation incl. profile switch, bonds with 9 ratings spanning AAA..BB, mutual-funds/top with 9 categories, precious-metals gold+silver with 12-pt trend, xirr-analytics 5 rows) plus signup-seeded 6 goals (with tier) and 4 milestones, plus auth-required guards. Frontend (Playwright on /app/networth, /app/goals, /app/transactions): Super Chart renders with 5 amount-milestone cards, all 4 range tabs switch, inflation Switch toggles, Scenario Simulator exposes exactly 5 sliders, Allocation Analytics 3 risk tabs (conservative/moderate/aggressive) work and Auto-rebalance click toasts, Bonds table shows 9 rows initially and exactly 3 AAA after filter, MF Analyst exposes 9 category tabs and 1-2 funds per category, Gold + Silver cards both render with 'Start staggered buy' working, XIRR Analytics shows 5 rows. design_issues.screen: NetWorth charts (Super Chart, Precious Metals trend, Allocation pies)
issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings repeatedly — ResponsiveContainer parents likely lack explicit min-height/aspect. Cosmetic but noisy in console (carryover from iter-2).
DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — a11y warning (carryover from iter-2).

action_items: (Optional, low-pri) Fix Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings by setting explicit min-height (e.g. 240px) on the ResponsiveContainer parents in NetWorth.jsx (super-chart, gold-trend, silver-trend, allocation pies).
(Optional, low-pri) Add `aria-describedby` / DialogDescription to NetWorth Add-milestone dialog and Transactions detail dialog.
(Future iter-4 phase-2) Replace mocked bond list, MF top, gold/silver spot, XIRR analytics with broker connect + MMTC/live feed integrations as planned.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now 1140 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, networth.py (incl. super-chart), holdings.py, milestones.py, allocation.py, markets.py (bonds/mf/metals/xirr), ai.py.

Path param shadowing: /api/networth/super-chart accepts `range: str` query param but `range` shadows Python's built-in `range()`; an explicit `range_years()` helper is defined to work around it. Rename the query param to `period` (or alias) to avoid the shadow.
/api/precious-metals trend_1y uses `random.uniform(-50, 50)` per request → trend points jitter on every refresh (non-deterministic UX, visible on the chart). Seed once or persist per user.
/api/allocation hard-codes `gold_est = 120000` and `rebalance_impact_15y = 3800000` regardless of user holdings — fine for MVP but should derive from user holdings/age in next iter.
/api/allocation `equity` detection greps account.institution for 'zerodha'/'groww' and `debt` for 'EPFO'/'PPF' (case-mixed). Brittle string match — move to an explicit `category` field on accounts.
Bonds list, MF list, gold/silver spot, XIRR analytics all hard-coded inside route handlers. Extract to /app/backend/seeds/markets.py for cleaner testing/diffing.
